answer_1.quote: The GPTGEOCHAT benchmark ( §3) consists of dialogues between a human and GPT-4v for the task of image geolocation to five location granularities.
answer_1.outputs: multimodal conversations between a human and a model (GPT-4v), with the intent to geolocate each image

answer_2.quote: At the message level, we utilize the standard f1-score metric.

answer_3.quote: Note that we use GPT3.5-Turbo instead of GPT4 because they perform similarly on this task.
methods: text-based LLM to extract revealed location from each response

answer_4.quote: We employ in-house annotators who are paid $18 per hour to curate and annotate data in GPTGEOCHAT.
answer_4.guideline: After you ask a question and receive an answer from the model, you should select the most specific location granularity and provide the strings / coordinates in the corresponding fields.
